products.name: Vizard AI
products.note: Video repurposing; auto-clipping; social media; content strategy AI

profile_text.body:
Vizard is a web-based video editing platform that describes itself as the number one AI video editing and clipping tool. The company's core offering is the conversion of long-form video content into short clips formatted for social media channels such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms, with the site emphasizing minimal manual effort through AI-driven automation.

The platform's main product, Vizard AI, includes tools for auto-clipping, subtitle generation, video translation, audio transcription, and channel-specific editors for Instagram and TikTok. Vizard also offers a Team Workspace feature that the company describes as a centralized hub for project management, real-time viewing, and sharing previews with clients or external team members. Additional tools listed on the site include an AI podcast clip generator, a YouTube clip maker, and a YouTube Shorts maker.

The held facts confirm that Vizard maintains a profile on theworldofai.org and that its primary product is categorized under Video Generation and Editing. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are associated with the company in the available data.
